name: Nakashinden Shouta
source:
Itsuki's friend at school. He encourages Itsuki to go to the island with him but never explains what it's about though he knows himself. [url=https://vndb.org/c23743]Touko[/url] confesses to him at the confession event and the two start going out but don't mind each other having sex with others too.

He's often seen in the background in group settings.
